Yummy Seafood Buffet Dinner
Sep 2019
The cafe is located in the renamed Saigon Prince Hotel, formerly known as the Duxton Hotel, located in one of the busiest and most visited walking streets in the heart of the city center.

It was a rainy Saturday evening, we came by here for the seafood buffet dinner and it was crowded but most diners arrived around 7pm (we arrived at 6.15pm). The seafood buffet is only available from Thursdays to Saturdays between 6pm to 10pm. 

The restaurant has a nice and cosy ambience, spacious, bright and clean. Staff were very friendly and smiles were all on their faces, very efficient in clearing used plates frequently without the need to remind them and initiating conversations with diners.

As for the food spread, variety and quality, they were excellent. Other than lobsters which diners can only order once per person, all the other food were served unlimited and especially for the seafood, you can request from the chefs and choose how they are to be cooked and in what sauces you like. The seafood included lobsters, huge "big-head" shrimps, crabs, crayfish, oysters. mussels, white and bamboo clams etc. They were very fresh and huge!

Other cooked food items included stewed beef, fried noodles, rosemary chicken, cream of mushroom and local flavour soups, assortment of Japanese sushi and sashimi, local delights, pastries, fruits, ice cream etc. There were also meat and vegetable stickers where the chefs will BBQ for you. But we mainly aimed for the seafood only, extremely delicious!

In terms of areas of improvement, which we felt was necessary and essential was that it does not provide any drinking water to diners, something most high end restaurants will do so. Having said that, diners can order drinks or juices (and other beverages), and a can of coke costs 64K dong (which you can get one at 10K in a convenience shop)! We didn't order any drink because we felt that it was not worth and since we had plan to visit one of the coffee chains at the Cafe Apartment (please refer to my earlier review here) located opposite the hotel, we skipped. Luckily the soup and fruits managed to "quenched" our thirst to some extent! 

Overall, it was a great value for money considering the delicious and wide variety of seafood and other cooked food items. 

For diners, if you make your reservation 2 days' in advance, you will be able to enjoy a good 15% discount (from the base price of $599K, excluding the tax and VAT), so it's great to make your reservation in advance not only to secure your table and yet enjoy special discounts! Why not?

It is one of the nice seafood buffet restaurants that is reasonably priced comparing to other "premium" ones offering similar food (maybe a little more dishes with drinks inclusive) but is almost double it's price!

My family and I enjoyed our dinning here and when we return to HCMC next time (we visit HCMC at least once every year), we will surely dropby here again! Highly recommeneded.

I will share my dinning photos once this post is approved as Tripadvisor somehow does not allow first reviewer to upload photos!
